stages.prompt: Survey the repo, docs, and skills relevant to the goal and gather the facts, constraints, and prior art the writer will need. Write your findings, each with a file path and line reference, to research.md.
Using the goal and the research notes, draft the milestone spec as a single, testable description of what must be true when the milestone is done. Write it to milestone.md. Inputs:
Review milestone.md against the goal and research.md for gaps, contradictions, and untestable claims. Write your verdict to review.json as {"verdict":"pass"|"revise","score":0-10,"issues":["..."]}.
Design the architecture that satisfies the milestone and record the key decisions, tradeoffs, and rejected alternatives. Write one ADR to adr.md. Inputs:
Revise the milestone spec to fix every issue the reviewer raised, keeping it a single testable description. Write the result to milestone.md.

Re-review milestone.md against the goal and the ADR in adr.md, checking that the earlier issues are resolved. Write your verdict to review.json as {"verdict":"pass"|"revise","score":0-10,"issues":["..."]}.
Assess the feasibility of the milestone and the ADR, calling out cost, risk, and any missing steps. Write your assessment to assessment.md. Inputs:
Revise the milestone spec once more, reconciling it with the ADR and the feasibility assessment. Write the result to milestone.md.
Final review of milestone.md against the goal, adr.md, and assessment.md for any remaining gaps. Write your verdict to review.json as {"verdict":"pass"|"revise","score":0-10,"issues":["..."]}.
Break the milestone into independently startable tickets, each naming the files it changes and its narrowest verification command. Write the tickets to TICKETS.md.
Check TICKETS.md covers every requirement in the milestone, with no gaps and no overlaps. Write your verdict to review.json as {"verdict":"pass"|"revise","score":0-10,"issues":["..."]}. Inputs:
